title: China
html:
China is an Asian country map in OpenFront by crunchybbb. It was added in Update 33.0 as a Qing-dynasty-themed map; Update 34.0 redrew it with modern borders (including the Amur river mouth), and the classic Qing-era map lives on as Qing China.

Nations

The map features 34 named nations based on modern provinces and regions, including Hong Kong, Guangdong, Sichuan, Heilongjiang, Inner Mongolia, Xinjiang and Tibet.

  • Categories: Countries, Asia, New
